own_solution.law: Impulse-momentum theorem: F_avg = m v (1 + e) / dt
assumptions: head-on rebound along the same line
stated speed and restitution apply to whatever body hits the wall

notes: F = 0.150*20*(1+0.6)/0.008 = 600 N. With 75 g clay on the ball (total 0.225 kg), same speed, e and contact time: F = 900 N. T1D0F 'was stuck to the ball before it hit the wall' is read as the clay remaining on the ball during the impact; a reader could wonder whether it stays on, but the natural reading is R. All numbered sentences state 75 g; 'small lump' sentences carry no number.
